outposts.name: Muttukadu & Siruseri Backwaters
outposts.desc: Scenic estuarine lagoon on the East Coast Road with sailing, windsurfing, speedboating, and rowing.

outposts.name: Covelong (Kovalam Beach)
outposts.desc: Historic Dutch port village turned surfing and windsurfing hub with crescent beach and fishing coves.

outposts.name: Tiruvallur & Poondi Reservoir
outposts.desc: Ancient 8th-century Veeraraghava Perumal temple and expansive Poondi reservoir dam with parklands.

outposts.name: Mahabalipuram (Mamallapuram UNESCO)
outposts.desc: 7th-century UNESCO World Heritage Shore Temple, Arjuna's Penance, Pancha Rathas & monolithic elephant carvings.

outposts.name: Pulicat Lake & Bird Sanctuary
outposts.desc: India's second-largest brackish lagoon, Dutch cemetery ruins & winter breeding ground for thousands of flamingos.

outposts.name: Sadras Dutch Fort
outposts.desc: 17th-century seaside brick fortification with watchtowers, colonial burial vaults, and casuarina-fringed beach.

outposts.name: Kanchipuram (City of Thousand Temples)
outposts.desc: Pallava & Chola temple architecture capital (Kailasanathar, Ekambareswarar) and world-famous pure mulberry silk weaving.

outposts.name: Nagalapuram (Siddulaiah Kona)
outposts.desc: Forest canyon river trekking with 3 consecutive natural freshwater swimming pools and sliding rocks.

outposts.name: Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary
outposts.desc: India's oldest water bird sanctuary (est. 1798), home to 40,000+ migratory herons, storks, and ibises in barringtonia groves.

outposts.name: Kailasakona Waterfalls
outposts.desc: Perennial crystalline mineral cascade dropping from 40 feet in the Nagari valley with Shiva-Parvati shrine.

outposts.name: Tada Falls (Ubbalamadugu)
outposts.desc: Rocky canyon trek through crystalline forest pools and waterfalls situated on the Tamil Nadu–Andhra border.

outposts.name: Nagari Nose (Nagari Hills)
outposts.desc: Dramatic cliff precipice shaped like a human nose rising high above Kushasthali river; popular trekking summit.

outposts.name: Srikalahasti
outposts.desc: Vayu Lingam (Air element) sanctum on the Swarnamukhi River, noted for ancient Rahu-Ketu parihara rituals.

outposts.name: Vellore Fort & Jalakanteshwara
outposts.desc: Imposing 16th-century Vijayanagara granite fortress surrounded by a massive water moat and exquisite carved temple pillars.

outposts.name: Chandragiri Fort & Raja Mahal
outposts.desc: Imposing granite citadel and Raja Mahal palace where Vijayanagara kings ruled during their final dynasty.

outposts.name: Tirupati & Tirumala
outposts.desc: Seven holy peaks of the Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve surrounded by red sandalwood reserves and waterfalls.

outposts.name: Auroville (City of Dawn)
outposts.desc: Experimental universal township anchored by the golden geodesic dome of Matrimandir and organic farms.

outposts.name: Pondicherry (Puducherry)
outposts.desc: French colonial White Town bougainvillea promenades, rock beach, French bakeries & bohemian Auroville community.

outposts.name: Gingee Fort (Senji)
outposts.desc: The Troy of the East: impregnable triple-citadel complex (Rajagiri, Krishnagiri, Chandrayandurg).

outposts.name: Mypadu Beach (Nellore)
outposts.desc: Pristine golden sand beach lined with casuarina groves and fresh seafood on the southern Andhra coast.

outposts.name: Tiruvannamalai (Arunachala)
outposts.desc: Agni Lingam (Fire element) temple at the base of sacred Mount Arunachala and Sri Ramana Maharshi ashram.

outposts.name: Yelagiri Hills
outposts.desc: Serene 14-hairpin mountain road leading to an orchard-covered Eastern Ghats basin.

outposts.name: Javadhu Hills
outposts.desc: Untouched blue-tinged hill range known for Vainu Bappu astronomical observatory and Beemanmadavu waterfalls.

outposts.name: Kaigal Falls (Dumukurallu)
outposts.desc: Unspoiled 40-foot waterfall cascading over natural rock fissures inside the Kaundinya elephant corridor.

outposts.name: Kaundinya Wildlife Sanctuary
outposts.desc: Only sanctuary in Andhra Pradesh with a thriving population of Asiatic elephants, leopards, and sloth bears.

outposts.name: Horsley Hills
outposts.desc: Cool Eastern Ghats highland plateau fringed with eucalyptus groves and scenic sunset cliffs.

outposts.name: Chidambaram & Pichavaram Mangrove
outposts.desc: Akasa Lingam (Space element) Nataraja temple & the world's second-largest mangrove forest explored by rowboats.

outposts.name: Gangaikonda Cholapuram
outposts.desc: Imperial capital founded by Rajendra Chola I after his conquest of the Ganges, featuring a massive living temple.

outposts.name: Tranquebar (Tharangambadi)
outposts.desc: Land of the Singing Waves: 1620 Danish Fort Dansborg, ozone-rich coastal breezes & quiet colonial churches on the coast.

outposts.name: Kumbakonam (Temple City)
outposts.desc: Sacred temple town between Kaveri and Arasalar rivers, Mahamaham tank & brass lamp metalworking.

outposts.name: Darasuram (Airavatesvara UNESCO)
outposts.desc: Exquisite 12th-century Chola chariot temple with musical steps and miniature stone stone-carving friezes.

outposts.name: Thirunallar (Karaikal)
outposts.desc: Legendary temple of Lord Dharbaranyeswarar and Saturn (Saneeswara) with sacred Nalan Theertham bathing tank.

outposts.name: Velankanni & Nagore
outposts.desc: Lourdes of the East Basilica on the Bay of Bengal coast alongside the historic 16th-century Sufi shrine of Nagore Dargah.

outposts.name: Nagapattinam (Soundararaja)
outposts.desc: Historic Chola seaport on the Bay of Bengal, ancient maritime trading hub with Burma and Sri Lanka.

outposts.name: Hogenakkal Falls
outposts.desc: Niagara of India: roaring Kaveri river cascading through carbonatite rock canyon with coracle boat rides.

outposts.name: Trichy (Rockfort & Srirangam)
outposts.desc: 83m monolithic Rockfort perched high above the Kaveri, and the 156-acre island temple complex of Sri Ranganathaswamy.

outposts.name: Thanjavur (Brihadisvara UNESCO)
outposts.desc: The Big Temple of Raja Raja Chola: 216-foot granite vimana topped with an 80-ton monolithic cupola & bronze gallery.

outposts.name: Mettur Dam & Stanley Reservoir
outposts.desc: One of India's largest masonry dams controlling the Kaveri River, bordered by rolling Shevaroy foothills.

outposts.name: Yercaud (Shevaroy Hills)
outposts.desc: Jewel of the South: tranquil coffee and orange plantation hill station overlooking the Salem plains.

outposts.name: Kolli Hills (Kolli Malai)
outposts.desc: Thrilling 70 continuous hairpin bends, Agaya Gangai waterfall plunge & ancient Arapaleeswarar temple.

outposts.name: Gandikota (The Grand Canyon)
outposts.desc: The Grand Canyon of India: sheer red sandstone gorge carved by the Pennar River below a 13th-century fort.

outposts.name: Chettinad (Karaikudi)
outposts.desc: Grand palatial mansions built by merchant bankers with Italian marble, Burmese teak, Athangudi tiles & fiery cuisine.

outposts.name: Belum Caves
outposts.desc: India's second-largest underground karst cave system with 3.2 km of limestone passages and sinkholes.

outposts.name: Sirumalai Hills
outposts.desc: Quiet isolated Eastern Ghats hill range with 18 hairpin bends, famous Sirumalai hill bananas & Sanjeevani hill lore.

outposts.name: Madurai
outposts.desc: Cultural capital of Tamil Nadu anchored by Meenakshi Amman Temple's towering polychromatic gopurams via 4-lane NH 45.

outposts.name: Srisailam (Mallikarjuna)
outposts.desc: Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga sanctum perched inside the deep Nallamala tiger sanctuary and massive Krishna dam gorge.

outposts.name: Coonoor
outposts.desc: Quieter Nilgiri sister station overlooking Catherine Falls, Droog Fort & manicured tea factory slopes.

outposts.name: Kodaikanal
outposts.desc: Princess of Hill Stations: star-shaped lake, Coaker's Walk precipice, silver pine woods & crisp mountain climate.

outposts.name: Ooty (Udhagamandalam)
outposts.desc: Queen of Hill Stations: rolling blue eucalyptus sholas, tea estates, Doddabetta Peak & steam railway.

outposts.name: Topslip (Anaimalai Tiger Reserve)
outposts.desc: Pristine teak woods, elephant rehabilitation camp, hornbills, and wilderness safari in the core Western Ghats.

outposts.name: Rameshwaram & Dhanushkodi
outposts.desc: Pamban rail bridge across the sea, Ramanathaswamy 1000-pillar corridor & Dhanushkodi border sand spit.

outposts.name: Munnar
outposts.desc: Top Station panoramic pass overlooking Tamil Nadu plains, tea estates & misty Nilgiri tahr sanctuary via Trichy–Theni.

outposts.name: Valparai
outposts.desc: Challenging 40 hairpin bends above Aliyar Dam into dense rain-soaked tea plantations and lion-tailed macaque habitat.
